name: zen-notes-widget
description: A lean notes widget for the Zen Browser sidebar with a global notes library and per-workspace pinned active note state
author: jjspscl
features: Global notes library with per-workspace pinned active note
Lean pinned sidebar widget above workspace indicators
Title trigger popover for note selection
Manager screen for create, rename, reorder, and hard delete
Legacy v1/v2 migration into the schema v3 data model
